description: Defines the QuicAlarm class and related delegate classes for scheduling and handling alarms in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicAlarm
classes.description: Represents an alarm that triggers at a scheduled time, executing a delegate's OnAlarm method.

classes.name: quic::QuicAlarm::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for alarm delegate with methods to get connection context and handle alarm firing.

classes.name: quic::QuicAlarm::DelegateWithContext
classes.description: Delegate implementation that stores a QuicConnectionContext*.

classes.name: quic::QuicAlarm::DelegateWithoutContext
classes.description: Delegate implementation without a connection context, suitable for handling many connections.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Schedules the alarm to fire at a specified deadline.

methods.name: PermanentCancel
methods.description: Permanently cancels the alarm, preventing future scheduling.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the alarm, but can be rescheduled later.

methods.name: IsPermanentlyCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the alarm has been permanently canceled.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the alarm's deadline if the new deadline is farther than the current, considering granularity.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the alarm's deadline has been set.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Invoked when the alarm fires, calling the delegate's OnAlarm method.
